## Banking Core Service

Spring Boot 3.3 / Java 21 service in `banking-core-service/`.

```bash
cd banking-core-service
mvn clean verify                 # unit + integration tests (H2 in MySQL mode)
JWT_SECRET=... DB_URL=... mvn spring-boot:run
```

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DB_URL` | yes (non-test) | `jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/banking_core` | MySQL JDBC URL |
| `DB_USERNAME` / `DB_PASSWORD` | yes | `root` / empty | Database credentials |
| `JWT_SECRET` | yes | — | HS256 signing secret, at least 32 bytes |
| `SERVER_PORT` | no | `8080` | HTTP port |
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_RETENTION` | no | `90d` | Notification data-retention period (history window and purge) |
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_DEFAULT_TZ` | no | `Europe/Zurich` | Time zone used when the client sends none |
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_PURGE_CRON` | no | `0 30 2 * * *` | Schedule of the retention purge job |

### Notification history (US-028)

- `GET /api/v1/notifications/history?category=&from=&lang=&tz=&page=&size=` — authenticated customer's
  notifications (customer taken from the JWT `customer_id` claim only).
- `GET /api/v1/notifications/history/labels?lang=` — localized screen labels (en, de, fr, it) and entry-point links.
- Screen: `/notification-history.html?from=dashboard|security-center|bill-payments`.
